meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自定义 AI 该记住哪些内容,按领域打标签并推送提醒
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 按自己的领域习惯记住要点并在关键记忆上收到提醒
copy.tagline_en: Customize what your assistant remembers, tag notes by domain, and fire alerts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to remember domain notes and alert you on key ones.

howto.what: Claude 会先问你在忙什么,再提一套自定义笔记类型和标签给你确认,据此创建并安装 claude-mem 模式、激活它;可选配置 Telegram 提醒,重启 worker 后验证该模式已出现在启动上下文里。
howto.when: 当你想改变 claude-mem 记什么时触发,比如新建或修改模式、增加观察类型或标签、为特定记忆设 Telegram 提醒等,即使你没说“mode”。

say.text: 帮我做一个跟踪法律案例的 claude-mem 模式
say.note: 它会先问你在做什么,再提类型和标签让你确认

say.text: 给这个模式的“实验结论”标签加 Telegram 提醒
say.note: 选中的任一类型或标签命中就发提醒

say.text: 把我现在的 code 模式改成跟踪设计决策的变体
say.note: 它会先查已有模式,再提改造方案

howto.what_en: Claude asks what you're working on, proposes a small set of custom note types and tags for your approval, writes and installs a claude-mem mode, optionally sets up Telegram alerts, restarts the worker, and verifies the mode appears in startup context.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to change what claude-mem remembers: create or edit a mode, add observation types or tags, or set Telegram alerts for particular memories, even if you don't say "mode."

say_en.text: Help me build a claude-mem mode for tracking legal cases.
say_en.note: It asks what you're working on first.

say_en.text: Add Telegram alerts for the experiment-outcomes tag in this mode.
say_en.note: Any selected type or tag triggers an alert.

say_en.text: Turn my code mode into a design-decision tracking variant.
say_en.note: It checks existing modes and proposes a remix.
